summary: Code quality is high: workflow uses proper pinned actions (v4), least-privilege permissions, job outputs, and fromJSON matrix parsing; Python script has comprehensive validation, error handling, and clear GitHub Actions integration. However, deliverable is substantially incomplete. Task explicitly requires: (1) TDD with failing tests first—none provided; (2) all tests run via act in workflow—no test step exists; (3) act-result.txt artifact—missing; (4) actionlint validation step—absent; (5) test fixture setup and exact-value assertions—not implemented. Only conftest.py (test infrastructure) shown; no actual test files or fixtures. Workflow only runs generator, not tests. Critical gaps violate core task requirements.
